title: You Are a Flame Wearing a Name Tag
voice_standard: Magnetic intellectual rogue: intimate, amused, conspiratorial, and vividly human; treats each idea like a secret worth savoring; moves freely through curiosity, concern, disbelief, dismissal, laughter, warmth, urgency, and awe; slows down for the reality-shifting lines, whispers the dangerous implications, laughs naturally at absurdity, and lands with humane authority; crisp consonants, elastic pacing, irresistible forward motion

scenes.text: Now look at yourself. Breath enters. Heat escapes. Cells repair, divide, and disappear. Food becomes movement. Sunlight becomes thought.

scenes.text: Yet someone looked at this magnificent traffic pattern, gave it a name, printed a certificate, and declared it an object. Very official.

scenes.text: Perhaps you are more like a whirlpool. The water constantly changes. The pattern remains. And because the pattern persists, someone points toward it and says, 'There it is.'

scenes.text: But try removing the river and keeping the whirlpool. There is nothing left to hold.

scenes.text: Your identity may not live inside one atom, one memory, or one frozen version of you. It lives in the continuation.

scenes.text: This means there may be no original you buried beneath all the changes. No permanent statue waiting to be uncovered. And maybe that is not a loss.
